title: Frozen algorithmic candidate matrix for same-endpoint temporal refinement characterization
purpose: Characterize whether a bounded same-endpoint refinement semantic can provide a scientifically useful temporal-error shape for nonstationary prescribed-bottom-head Richards execution. This matrix does not select production tolerances or admit a production estimator.

frozen_fixture_envelope.soil_and_geometry: source-locked four-node homogeneous F-GC02/F-SI20 fixture used by F-VQ28

same_endpoint_execution_rule.physical_origin: one frozen checkpoint for every refinement level of one trajectory
same_endpoint_execution_rule.attempt_context_origin: same frozen worker attempt context for every independent refinement level
same_endpoint_execution_rule.target_endpoint: t0 + target_horizon for every refinement level
same_endpoint_execution_rule.partition_semantics: N equal substeps over the same target horizon

endpoint_observables.additional_component_rule: Record when materialized by the tested production state/result seam; do not fabricate missing values.

defect_definitions.componentwise: absolute endpoint difference between U_N and U_2N, retaining each F-CI14 metric in its native unit
defect_definitions.successive_decay_ratio: d_2N / d_N for the same component when d_N > 0
defect_definitions.observed_order_diagnostic: log(d_N/d_2N)/log(2) when both defects are positive and finite
defect_definitions.zero_defect_rule: report exact zero and do not invent an order or ratio

C1.name: THREE_LEVEL_SAME_ENDPOINT_DECAY_GUARD
C1.advance_condition: component defects are finite, all level mass gates pass, all level solvers succeed, and d_2_4 <= d_1_2 for every materialized primary component
C1.reject_condition: any required component grows, becomes nonfinite, solver fails, or hard mass gate fails
C1.cost_warning: Seven physical solves is too expensive as a mandatory normal path under invariant 15.

C2.name: STAGED_TWO_LEVEL_WITH_BOUNDED_ESCALATION
C2.role: evaluate whether a cheap normal path plus selective same-endpoint escalation is structurally possible
C2.trigger_policy: NO_NUMERIC_TRIGGER_SELECTED_IN_F_SI21; characterize what information becomes available at each added level
C2.reuse_rule: previously computed U_2N may be retained as the coarser endpoint state for the next defect comparison, but finer trajectory integration still starts physically from the original checkpoint

C3.name: PERSISTENT_DECAY_REFERENCE_MODE
C3.role: reference-mode characterization and escalation oracle candidate, not normal production path
C3.persistent_decay_definition: two consecutive finite nonincreasing component defects, d_2N <= d_N and d_4N <= d_2N
C3.nonasymptotic_rule: fail closed if persistent decay is not established within N <= 32

predeclared_decision_rules.C1: May only be retained as a scientific shape candidate if every trajectory reaches N=4 and every materialized primary component satisfies nonincreasing successive defects. It cannot be selected as the normal production path because its fixed seven-solve cost already violates the bounded normal-path objective.
predeclared_decision_rules.C2: May advance to a separate policy-design step only if the N1/N2 pair is solver- and mass-safe on every trajectory and the characterization shows a bounded minority of trajectories needing escalation to establish persistent decay. No percentage threshold is interpreted as admission in this workunit; the measured distribution is evidence for a later bounded-cost policy decision.
predeclared_decision_rules.C3: May serve as a reference-mode algorithmic candidate only if persistent decay is established by N<=32 on every solver-reachable trajectory. Solver-unreachable trajectories are reported as reference-coverage gaps, not silently dropped.
predeclared_decision_rules.global_fail_closed: No candidate is promoted if any hard mass failure occurs. No production acceptance threshold is inferred from this characterization.

next_action: Implement a test-only source-locked characterization harness that executes the frozen 72 trajectories at N=1,2,4,8,16,32 from one physical checkpoint per trajectory and emits the predeclared diagnostics without changing production source.
